claims: Water is composed of two hydrogen atoms covalently bonded to one oxygen atom.
Water constitutes roughly 70% of the human body.
Pure water has a pH of 7.
Pure water has a neutral pH.
Pure water is neither acidic nor basic.
Water exists in solid, liquid, and gaseous states.
Climate change is increasingly causing severe, widespread droughts.
The United Nations promotes Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 6.
Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 6 aims to ensure safe water and sanitation access for all by 2030.
